name: aptible-mcp
description: Manage Aptible resources through the Model Context Protocol.
long_description: A local MCP server for inspecting and operating Aptible environments, apps, databases, backups, endpoints, drains, certificates, services, and operations.

aptible_token.title: Aptible access token
aptible_token.description: Optional Aptible access token. Leave blank to use an existing Aptible CLI login from ~/.aptible/tokens.json.

certificate_directory.title: Certificate directory
certificate_directory.description: Optional trusted directory containing certificate and private-key files used by uploadCertificate.
